newsitem.title: USA: FIND/SVP sees Q3 loss, cites lower revs.
newsitem.headline: FIND/SVP sees Q3 loss, cites lower revs.

text.p: FIND/SVP Inc said on Friday its third quarter results would show a net loss from operations of between $0.03 and $0.05 per share, due mostly to an unexpected revenue drop, plus normal summer weakness in custom research revenues.

The company, which provides outsourced research and business intelligence services, also said it would take a $0.04 to $0.06 per share restructuring charge in the third quarter, because of planned changes in its publishing operations and in anticipation of a more aggressive growth strategy.
The total net loss for the quarter would therefore be between $0.07 and $0.10 per share, the company said.

FIND/SVP said it had an unexpected decline in revenues from published reports. President Andrew Garvin said the publishing revenue levels recovered somewhat in September, but not enough to prevent the anticipated loss.

But Garvin said the company would have positive cash flow from operating activities in the quarter, despite the loss. FIND/SVP also said, as part of its growth strategy, it received a new $5 million financing arrangement led by Furman Selz Investments LLC.

The restructuring charge would cover charges associated with restructuring its publishing businesses, including the planned sale or closing of certain small properties that were losing money, and adjustments to inventory, the company said. It also covered anticipated charges associated with changes in strategy and operations, it said.
